label: Lead
name: lead/1
note: A lead of Butler James, Maia City's CRM table (intent a6ae861e): a firm we may sell to, its contact as published, its website, and where it stands in our pipeline. Every lead is named by its UUID; its company, email and website are only data (one website, else one email, kept once: play/api/src/leads.ts). The stages are this schema's enum, so the pipeline changes by proposal. Nothing in Butler James sends mail or calls (German UWG §7: a B2B cold email needs consent, a cold call presumed consent): do_not_contact is kept and shown.

node.description: A lead is { schema: 'lead/1', company, contact, email, website, phone, city, region, firm, segment, source, stage, lost_reason, next_step, next_date, notes, found_at, do_not_contact, operator }: add it with add_lead and change it with update_lead, which hold every field to its form.

contact.description: the person to speak to, as the firm publishes them

email.description: the contact email as the firm publishes it (Impressum or Kontakt), never guessed

firm.description: solo: one Makler; partners: 1–3 partners; family: a family business; traditional: a Traditionsfirma; owner_run: inhabergeführt

segment.description: what it sells, e.g. 'Verkauf, Häuser und Wohnungen ab €500k'

source.description: how it came to us: form (it wrote to us), cold (we found it), referral, other

stage.description: where it stands in our pipeline: researched → contacted_call / contacted_email → reached (talked or replied) → meeting → offer → won / lost

found_at.description: the page its data was found on

operator.description: the admin who added it (a human's UUID)
